name: application-recent-pinned-switcher
title: Recent / Pinned Switcher
description: Workspace/project switcher panel with a search field, a Pinned section, and a Recent section, plus a create-workspace action.
useWhen: Users belong to or work across multiple workspaces/organizations/projects and need to switch between them quickly.
Some destinations are used often enough to warrant pinning above the general recency-ordered list.
The switcher list is long enough that a search field meaningfully speeds up finding a specific workspace.
avoidWhen: There's only one workspace per user — a switcher has nothing to switch between and just adds UI weight.
You need a generic labeled menu of unrelated actions — use `dropdown` for that, not this workspace-specific composition.
Pinning/recency isn't a meaningful concept for your list — a plain searchable `combobox` is simpler without the two-section split.
responsiveBehavior: Fixed-width popover-style panel; anchor it to a trigger button (e.g. the current workspace name in a top bar) and let your popover/positioning layer handle placement.
accessibility: The active workspace carries aria-current="true" in addition to its highlighted background and checkmark, so assistive tech can identify the current selection.
The search field has an associated (visually hidden) label rather than relying on placeholder text alone.
Section headings ("Pinned", "Recent") are visible text landmarks, helping users scan without relying on icon meaning alone.
Each workspace row's colored initial avatar is paired with the workspace name as text, never color/initial alone.

variants.title: Recent / Pinned Switcher
variants.description: Search field, a Pinned section with the active workspace checked, a Recent section, and a Create workspace action.
accessibility: Typing in the search field filters both the Pinned and Recent lists live against real workspace data.

variants.title: Recent / Pinned Switcher (Dark)
variants.description: Workspace switcher adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Active-row and section-heading colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
